subject: Owlbear
picture: A huge owlbear stands in a cave den. Owl head with a hooked beak and two ear tufts, bear body with thick limbs and a short tail. Two wings folded against the back as large shapes. One front paw rests on a broken crate. Cave ceiling, rock walls, large floor stones, closed tunnel mouth as boards and rock. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
